actions.action: Independently review the six merged stage manuals for accuracy, and the insurance content for domain correctness. They were merged without any reader other than their author.
evidence_required: Written review verdict per stage page
Named reviewer who is not the implementing agent
stop_conditions: The reviewer is the same agent that authored the pages
actions.fallback: Record the pages explicitly as unreviewed so the gap stays visible rather than fading.

actions.action: Fix the validator fail-open defect recorded in issue #5 before further content is written.
evidence_required: Malformed input produces CONTINUITY_VALIDATION=FAIL with no traceback
stop_conditions: The fix cannot be shown failing before it is trusted
actions.fallback: Continue with content and accept that every PASS is weaker evidence than it appears.

actions.action: Author the final three stage manuals: Discover, Define and Learn.
prerequisites: The six-stage pattern accepted in review
evidence_required: Three stage pages at executable depth
stop_conditions: The pattern is rejected and needs revision first
actions.fallback: Revise the six existing pages before writing more.

actions.action: Resequence or close issue #2 (WP-003), clearing the recorded divergence.
actions.fallback: Keep it open with the divergence recorded.

actions.action: Select GitHub Actions as the GitHub Pages publishing source. Until this is done every push to main fails at Configure Pages.
prerequisites: Repository content approved for public access
actions.fallback: Leave undeployed and continue local preview only.

actions.action: Decide whether to delete the four merged feature branches on the remote.
evidence_required: Branch list showing the decision applied
stop_conditions: A branch is still referenced by an open pull request
actions.fallback: Leave them; they are harmless but accumulate.
